name: SmartWoo – AI Product Content, SEO & Image Generator for WooCommerce
author: Coder Vex

sections.description:
SmartWoo brings AI-powered product creation directly into WooCommerce.

Generate and optimize product content, SEO metadata, featured images, and coordinated gallery images without switching between multiple AI tools.

SmartWoo connects your WooCommerce store to the SmartWoo API, so you do not need to purchase, configure, or manage your own OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic, or other AI provider API keys.

Create your SmartWoo account, connect your store, choose a product, and start generating.

Complete AI Product Creation for WooCommerce

Content + SEO + Images. One WooCommerce AI workflow.

Instead of manually moving between AI chat tools, SEO tools, image generators, and your WooCommerce dashboard, SmartWoo brings the workflow together inside WordPress.

SmartWoo can help you create and optimize:

  • Product titles
  • Short product descriptions
  • Full product descriptions
  • Product tags
  • Product attributes
  • SEO titles
  • SEO meta descriptions
  • SEO keywords
  • Image alt text
  • Featured product images
  • Product gallery images
  • Bulk product content

Generated content can be reviewed before you apply it to your WooCommerce products.

AI Product Content Generator

Create product content directly from your WooCommerce workflow.

SmartWoo can generate content based on available product information and your generation settings.

Supported product-content workflows can include:

  • AI product titles
  • Short descriptions
  • Full descriptions
  • Product tags
  • Product attributes
  • Product-focused content
  • Content rewriting and optimization

Use SmartWoo to create content for new products or improve existing WooCommerce listings.

AI Product Description Generator

Writing product descriptions manually can take significant time, especially when managing a large WooCommerce catalog.

SmartWoo helps generate:

  • Short product descriptions
  • Detailed product descriptions
  • Product-focused sales copy
  • Structured product information
  • Rewritten product content

Review the generated content before applying it to your product.

WooCommerce AI SEO Generator

Create product-focused SEO metadata without manually writing every field.

SmartWoo’s supported SEO workflows can generate:

  • SEO titles
  • Meta descriptions
  • SEO keywords
  • Product tags
  • Image alt text

This helps WooCommerce store owners prepare more complete and search-friendly product information.

SmartWoo does not guarantee search-engine rankings. Generated SEO content should be reviewed before publication.

AI Featured Image Generator

Generate product-focused images with AI and use them in your WooCommerce product workflow.

Instead of generating an image on another platform, downloading it, and manually uploading it to WordPress, SmartWoo helps bring AI image generation closer to your WooCommerce workflow.

Depending on your SmartWoo account, plan, and available credits, image-generation features may allow you to create product imagery based on product information and prompts.

AI Gallery Image Generator

Build a more complete product presentation with AI-generated gallery images.

SmartWoo’s AI Gallery Image Generator helps create coordinated product visuals around the same WooCommerce product.

Gallery generation can be useful for creating additional product presentation images, concepts, scenes, backgrounds, and other supported visual variations.

Always review generated images before publishing them to your store.

Bulk AI Generation

Managing hundreds of WooCommerce products one by one can be time-consuming.

SmartWoo includes bulk-generation workflows designed to help process multiple products more efficiently.

Depending on your SmartWoo plan and available credits, bulk workflows may be used for supported content-generation and optimization tasks across multiple WooCommerce products.

This can be useful for:

  • Large WooCommerce catalogs
  • Existing stores requiring content updates
  • Dropshipping stores
  • Product migrations
  • SEO optimization projects
  • Ecommerce agencies
  • Stores importing supplier products

No Personal AI API Keys Required

You do not need to configure your own AI provider API keys to use SmartWoo’s managed AI-generation features.

SmartWoo communicates with the SmartWoo API, which handles supported AI services and model routing.

This means you do not need to separately configure API credentials for supported providers such as OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic, or other AI services used by the SmartWoo platform.

A SmartWoo account and available SmartWoo credits are required for AI-generation requests.

Smart AI Model Selection

SmartWoo can provide different AI model-selection capabilities depending on your subscription plan and available platform features.

These may include:

  • Automatic model selection
  • Economy AI tier
  • Standard AI tier
  • Premium AI tier
  • AI provider selection
  • Exact AI model selection

SmartWoo can route requests to appropriate supported AI models based on the selected generation mode.

Provider and exact-model selection may only be available on eligible plans.

Available AI providers and models may change as the SmartWoo platform evolves.

Free SmartWoo Plan

You can start using SmartWoo with a free account.

The free plan is designed to let WooCommerce store owners connect a store and test supported SmartWoo features before deciding whether they need a paid plan.

Free and paid accounts are subject to their respective:

  • AI credit limits
  • Product limits
  • Store limits
  • Feature permissions
  • Model-selection permissions
  • Usage limits

Current plan information is available at:

SmartWoo pricing page

Who Is SmartWoo For?

SmartWoo is designed for people and businesses that manage WooCommerce product catalogs.

It can be useful for:

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Ecommerce businesses
  • Dropshipping stores
  • WordPress developers
  • WooCommerce developers
  • WordPress freelancers
  • Ecommerce agencies
  • SEO professionals
  • Product managers
  • Stores with large product catalogs

Whether you are creating your first WooCommerce products or managing a larger catalog, SmartWoo is designed to reduce repetitive product-content work.

SmartWoo for Dropshipping Stores

Supplier product information is often generic, incomplete, or unsuitable for publishing directly on your store.

SmartWoo can help turn available product information into more complete WooCommerce product content.

Depending on the workflow and available product data, you can use SmartWoo to help generate descriptions, SEO metadata, tags, attributes, and product imagery.

SmartWoo does not automatically guarantee unique content, SEO performance, sales, or marketplace compliance. Store owners should review generated content before publication.

SmartWoo for WooCommerce Agencies

SmartWoo can also be used by developers, freelancers, and agencies managing WooCommerce stores.

Higher SmartWoo plans may provide additional capabilities such as:

  • Higher AI credit limits
  • Higher product limits
  • Multiple connected stores
  • Bulk generation
  • Advanced AI model selection
  • Provider selection
  • Exact model selection
  • Priority processing
  • Other premium platform features

See the SmartWoo pricing page for current plan limits and features.

How SmartWoo Works

Getting started is simple:

  1. Install and activate SmartWoo.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Open SmartWoo from your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Sign in to or create your SmartWoo account.
  5. Connect your WooCommerce store to SmartWoo.
  6. Open a product or supported SmartWoo generation workflow.
  7. Select the content or image you want to generate.
  8. Send the generation request.
  9. Review the AI-generated result.
  10. Apply or save the result to your WooCommerce product.

Why Use SmartWoo?

A typical AI product-content workflow may require several different services.

For example:

  1. Open an AI chat service.
  2. Create a product prompt.
  3. Copy the generated description.
  4. Return to WooCommerce.
  5. Paste and format the content.
  6. Open an SEO tool.
  7. Prepare metadata.
  8. Open an image-generation service.
  9. Generate product images.
  10. Download the images.
  11. Upload them to WordPress.
  12. Add image alt text.
  13. Repeat the process for the next product.

SmartWoo is designed to reduce these repetitive steps by bringing supported AI product workflows into WooCommerce.

Generate. Review. Apply.

SmartWoo Account and API

SmartWoo is an API-connected plugin.

The WordPress plugin acts as the WooCommerce interface while AI-generation requests are processed through the SmartWoo service.

A SmartWoo account is required to use API-powered AI-generation functionality.

You can manage your SmartWoo account, subscription, connected stores, usage, and available credits through the SmartWoo portal.

SmartWoo

Pricing

Documentation

External Services

SmartWoo relies on the external SmartWoo API to provide AI-powered generation functionality.

When you request AI-generated content or images, the plugin sends information required to perform that request to the SmartWoo API.

Depending on the feature being used, information sent to the SmartWoo API may include:

  • Product title
  • Product description
  • Short description
  • Product attributes
  • Product tags
  • Product categories or related product information
  • User-entered AI prompts
  • AI generation settings
  • Image-generation prompts
  • Product information required for the selected generation workflow
  • Store/API authentication information required to authenticate the request

The SmartWoo API processes the request and returns the generated result to your WordPress site.

The SmartWoo service may use third-party AI providers to process supported AI-generation requests.

The exact data sent depends on the SmartWoo feature you choose to use.

No AI-generation request is intended to be sent merely because the plugin is installed. Requests are made when SmartWoo functionality requiring the external service is used.

By creating a SmartWoo account and using SmartWoo API-powered features, you agree to the applicable SmartWoo terms and privacy practices.

Third-Party AI Services

The SmartWoo API may use supported third-party AI providers to fulfill generation requests.

The provider used may depend on:

  • Requested feature
  • SmartWoo plan
  • AI quality tier
  • Model availability
  • Automatic routing
  • Provider selection
  • Exact model selection
  • Platform configuration

Supported providers and models may change over time.

SmartWoo users do not normally need to provide their own third-party AI provider API keys when using SmartWoo’s managed AI service.

For current information about supported AI services and data handling, review the SmartWoo documentation and privacy policy.

Important AI Content Notice

AI-generated content and images may contain errors, inaccuracies, unsuitable wording, unexpected visual elements, or other issues.

You should always review AI-generated output before publishing it.

SmartWoo does not guarantee:

  • Search-engine rankings
  • Increased sales
  • Conversion improvements
  • Content accuracy
  • Product-information accuracy
  • Image accuracy
  • Legal or regulatory compliance
  • Marketplace approval
  • Copyright or trademark suitability

The store owner is responsible for reviewing and approving generated content before publication.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for SmartWoo.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Activate SmartWoo.
  6. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  7. Open SmartWoo from your WordPress dashboard.
  8. Sign in to or create your SmartWoo account.
  9. Connect your WooCommerce store.
  10. Start generating product content, SEO metadata, or images.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the SmartWoo plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Select the SmartWoo ZIP file.
  5. Click Install Now.
  6. Activate the plugin.
  7. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  8. Open SmartWoo.
  9. Connect your SmartWoo account and store.
  10. Start using the available AI tools.
sections.faq:
What is SmartWoo?

SmartWoo is an AI-powered product content, SEO, and image-generation solution designed for WooCommerce.

It connects your WordPress store to the SmartWoo API and provides supported AI-generation workflows directly from your WooCommerce environment.

Does SmartWoo require WooCommerce?

Yes. SmartWoo is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores.

WooCommerce should be installed and active before using SmartWoo’s WooCommerce functionality.

Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

No. SmartWoo’s managed AI service does not require you to configure your own OpenAI API key.

Do I need Google AI or Anthropic API keys?

No. You do not normally need to configure personal AI provider API keys when using SmartWoo’s managed AI service.

SmartWoo handles supported AI-provider integrations through the SmartWoo API.

Do I need a SmartWoo account?

Yes.

A SmartWoo account is required for API-powered AI-generation functionality because connected stores, credits, subscriptions, usage, and feature permissions are managed by the SmartWoo platform.

Is SmartWoo free?

SmartWoo provides a free plan with usage limits.

Paid plans provide higher limits and additional features.

For current limits and pricing, visit:

SmartWoo Pricing

Can SmartWoo generate product titles?

Yes. SmartWoo supports AI-assisted WooCommerce product-title generation as part of its supported product-content workflow.

Can SmartWoo generate product descriptions?

Yes.

SmartWoo can generate supported short and full product descriptions based on available product information and generation settings.

Can SmartWoo generate SEO metadata?

Yes.

Supported SEO-generation features can include SEO titles, meta descriptions, keywords, tags, and image alt text.

Does SmartWoo guarantee higher Google rankings?

No.

SmartWoo helps generate SEO-related content, but no plugin or AI service can guarantee search-engine rankings.

SEO results depend on many factors outside SmartWoo.

Can SmartWoo generate product images?

Yes.

SmartWoo provides supported AI image-generation functionality for WooCommerce product workflows, subject to your plan, credits, and available SmartWoo features.

Can SmartWoo create product gallery images?

Yes.

SmartWoo includes an AI Gallery Image Generator designed to help create coordinated product visuals.

Can I generate content for multiple WooCommerce products?

SmartWoo provides bulk-generation workflows.

Availability, product limits, and AI usage depend on your SmartWoo subscription plan and available credits.

Can I choose the AI provider?

Provider-selection capabilities depend on your SmartWoo plan.

Some plans may use automatic model selection, while eligible plans may provide provider or exact-model selection.

Where are AI requests processed?

AI-generation requests are sent to the SmartWoo API.

The SmartWoo service may use supported third-party AI providers to fulfill those requests.

Review the External Services section, SmartWoo documentation, and SmartWoo privacy policy for additional information.

Does SmartWoo automatically publish AI-generated content?

SmartWoo is designed to let users review supported generated results as part of the generation workflow.

You should always review AI-generated content and images before publishing them.

Where can I find SmartWoo documentation?

Documentation is available at:

SmartWoo Documentation

Where can I manage my SmartWoo account?

You can access the SmartWoo platform at:

SmartWoo platform
